verdict.rationale: An independent TechPowerUp review reports this exact part's memory type (GDDR6 at 20 Gbps), bus width (256-bit) and bandwidth (640 GB/s). No first-party AMD spec page with memory details is in the pack: the product page was unreachable, and the ROCm docs only cite a generic 'up to 48GB of VRAM' across Radeon GPUs, not this part. Memory capacity for the RX 9070 XT is not evidenced at all. Missing for 10: memory capacity for this exact part, a first-party vendor spec sheet listing capacity/type/bus width/bandwidth.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, memory specs are published in full for this exact part — capacity, memory type, bus width, and bandwidth

citations.quote: the RX 9070 XT keeps older GDDR6 memory at 20 Gbps (640 GB/s on a 256-bit bus)
